title: Volatility breakout with trend confirmation vs mean reversion with regime filters

fees.source_or_basis: Explicit baseline assumption; verify actual exchange fee tier.

breakout.entry_definition: Close crosses above prior N-bar Donchian high; EMA50>EMA200; close>EMA50; ATR14 above its SMA20; volume>SMA20 volume.
breakout.exit_definition: Stop at entry minus 2*ATR14 measured at signal close; target 2R or 3R; stop-first if both touch.

mean_reversion.entry_definition: Close crosses below Bollinger(20,2) lower band; RSI14<threshold; EMA50>EMA200; ATR14 <=1.5 times its 20-bar mean.
mean_reversion.exit_definition: Stop at entry minus configured ATR multiple; exit next open after close crosses above BB middle or max holding time 72 hours.

holdout_policy: Run holdout only for predeclared baseline configurations, never for the parameter grid.
